survivors.crates/genui-core/src/syntax/extract.rs:: Equivalent: the arm only chooses whether an unfenced continuation line is fed to program() character-by-character or accumulated in self.line and passed to line() at the newline. In Mode::Unfenced, line() calls program(line) directly, and program() slices raw from program_cursor to the current raw_end, which includes the newline in both paths. Segment text, program_raw bytes, cursor updates and diagnostics are identical.

Equivalent: with the guard false, a line inside Mode::Program(fence) is accumulated and passed to line() at the newline. line() in Program mode calls closes(line, fence) and otherwise calls program(line). The original guard true path only exists for lines whose first byte is not the fence marker; closes() returns None for exactly those lines because fence() rejects a different first byte, so line() also falls through to program(line). Bytes, segments and fence state match.

Equivalent: this predicate only chooses between immediate Route::Markdown and continued Route::Hold probing for a line that has not produced statement_start. When it wrongly holds, the line is flushed at the newline through line(): mode is still Prose, seen is false, and starts_program(line) is false because three or more probed tokens already failed statement_start and a later token cannot complete that header. The line is therefore rendered as the same Markdown segment.

Equivalent: the two-token clause also only decides Markdown-vs-Hold for a non-statement prefix. If it wrongly holds a two-token line, the newline flush calls line() with mode Prose and seen false; a two-token query/bind prefix is not a complete statement_start, so starts_program is false and the same Markdown text is emitted. If it wrongly marks Markdown for the 'query' case, that two-token prefix likewise could not have become a program statement.

Equivalent: this joins the same Markdown/Hold decision. The mutant can only defer an early Markdown decision to the newline flush. Every case satisfies one of: three or more tokens that already failed statement_start, a first token that starts_program rejects (uppercase or digit), or a two-token prefix that is not a complete header. None can make starts_program(line) true at the flush, so the emitted Markdown segment is unchanged.

Equivalent: compact_raw only discards already-consumed bytes and advances raw_base by the same count. program() always indexes self.raw relative to raw_base using absolute raw_end/program_cursor offsets. With compaction disabled, raw_base remains 0 and the full byte history remains in raw, so every slice start..end is identical; only retained memory grows.

Equivalent: count is a usize. When count == 0, draining ..0 removes nothing and raw_base += 0 leaves state unchanged, exactly as skipping the branch. For count > 0 both versions drain and advance identically.
